modeling_note: gRPC connections are a single multiplexed HTTP/2 connection per target, not a traditional client connection pool. 'Connection pool' as a scored item is treated as NOT_APPLICABLE for gRPC targets in this and subsequent gRPC-based services in this corpus, rather than UNVERIFIED, since the underlying mechanism the profile item describes does not exist in this transport model. Recommended for explicit codification in a future profile revision (MS-1.2).

mechanisms.name: timeout
mechanisms.resolved_value: ABSENT — and worse than the other CE points
mechanisms.resolution_path: this call uses context.TODO() instead of the inbound ctx parameter, discarding any caller-set deadline and any cancellation propagation entirely, rather than merely lacking its own timeout

set_aside.name: deadline/cancellation propagation discarded (context.TODO() replacing inbound ctx)
set_aside.note: Not in the MS-1.1 penalty table. This is a distinct anti-pattern from timeout absence: it actively breaks the caller's ability to bound or cancel this sub-call, which is a stronger claim than 'no timeout was added.' Recommended as a new MS-1.2 penalty: 'deadline propagation break' (candidate weight: -2, in the same class as timeout inversion since both defeat a timeout that exists elsewhere in the call chain).

set_aside.name: non-idempotent operation with no retry present
set_aside.note: Charge is a payment-mutating call. No retry is present, so the SE/CE retry-over-non-idempotent-write penalty does not trigger (it requires retry to be present); flagged for visibility since the absence of retry here is arguably correct given no idempotency key exists, but is worth human review.

penalties.name: unconditional_liveness
penalties.evidence: main.go:222-224 — the gRPC health Check() RPC returns SERVING unconditionally, with no reference to the state of any of the six downstream connections it holds; this handler is wired as this pod's liveness probe

totals.domains_rationale: Single domain: checkout orchestration. All six downstream calls serve one business transaction (place order).

remediation.action: Make the gRPC health Check() handler conditional — reflect actual state of the six downstream connections (e.g., via grpc-go's built-in health server SetServingStatus, updated by connection state watchers)
remediation.rationale: Removes the -3 penalty first; currently both readiness and liveness are structurally blind.

remediation.action: Add explicit per-call timeouts (context.WithTimeout) to all six downstream RPCs, replacing the bare inherited context
remediation.rationale: Largest single gap: no call in the checkout path currently has a bounded deadline of its own.

remediation.action: Fix the currencyservice call to use the inbound ctx instead of context.TODO()
remediation.rationale: Restores cancellation propagation; cheap, high-value fix distinct from adding a new timeout.

remediation.action: Add circuit breakers on cartservice, productcatalogservice, and paymentservice calls (the three most consequential paths)
remediation.rationale: Requires the timeouts from step 2 as prerequisite for full credit.

remediation.action: Add fallback behaviour for shippingservice (quote) and currencyservice (convert) — both are candidates for degraded-but-continuing behaviour, unlike payment which should fail closed
remediation.rationale: Not every failure should be swallowed; payment intentionally has no fallback recommended here.

remediation.action: Add SIGTERM handling with grpc.Server.GracefulStop() and a bounded drain period
remediation.rationale: Every redeploy currently risks in-flight order loss.

remediation.action: Add a startup probe distinct from liveness, and a PodDisruptionBudget
remediation.rationale: Lower-weight items; cheap to add once the above is in place.
